purpose: MXF Clip Name owner/text reading comparison and compact-retention recommendation for Bella.
request: OK, let's lock those FileMobId and MasterMobId rules in for Bella. Next, how do Media Composer and MDVX read Clip Name from MXF, and what should Bella read and keep?
status: MXF identity rules and the five focused Clip Name rules were approved separately on 2026-10-22. Clip Name requirements remain unimplemented; historical research findings and limits are unchanged.

mediaComposer.method: Read-only selective installed arm64 disassembly, vtable slot resolution and manual reconstruction of the managed MXF mob-to-name import path. No app/privateAPI/parser execution or media reads.

findings.evidence: Both scanner paths enumerate and classify master/file mobs then call domain virtual slot0x1f8 (e.g. LocalMDB0x41bdf8 and MSMDB0x44e70c). The inspected MXFDomain/AAFDomain vtables map this to CopyOut. CopyOut qualifies the mob role, creates a composition and calls virtualslot0xbe8 at0x4a374. AComposition vtable maps that to ConvertCompositionFromAAF. This connects the selected name import block to ordinary scanner mob import rather than an unrelated legacy string helper.

Name block starts with countzero0x1942b4, calls IAAFMob GetNameBufLen via0x38 at0x1942cc, allocates a widebuffer if countnonzero, calls GetName via0x30 at0x194308. Successful GetName passes wide name to ConvertUnicodeToInternal at0x194318 and AComposition virtualname setter0x2a8 at0x194334, resolving to AComponent::SetNameCopy0x1494e8. No physicalfilename fallback or SourcePackage.Name lookup appears in this local name block; master import gets the name of its supplied master.

findings.topic: Toolkit name property presence and bounds
findings.evidence: Both methods access the name property at this+0x118 and check presence. GetName checks recorded size against supplied destination size, then copies typed stored text. Getter names/vtable establish these calls are Name, not project or trackname. This is after typed toolkit decoding, not direct raw UTF16 byte interpretation.

findings.topic: Internal Unicode conversion is not lossless proof
findings.evidence: If domain flag+0x2b2 equals1, conversion calls TrimBadUnicodeToAsci then wcstombs. Otherwise uses AvText with systemencoding constants then copies resulting charstring. This does not make wireName MacRoman/UTF8, prove lossless everyUnicode character or require Bella to use the same locale/intermediate encoding. Raw MXFName UTF16BE is established separately by schema and ST377-1.

Caller ignores lengthgetter HRESULT but initializedcountzero. Zero count enters role-dependent missingname handling; some roles emit Missing clip name, physicaldescriptor conditions can omit warning. Failed GetName skips converter/setter, bypassing warningblock. Normally stored emptyterminated text with nonzero storage can follow normalconversion. No universal UIplaceholder, allerrortransactionality or filenamefallback asserted.

textPipeline.wire: UTF16BE field bytes; mxf_get_utf16string_item0x10004993c swaps each2-byte BE codeunit to host mxfUTF16Char (4-byte slots in this build).
textPipeline.path: get_string_value0x100011b08 -> mxf_get_utf16string_item_size0x1000498bc -> malloc -> mxf_get_utf16string_item -> convert_string0x100011c7c -> mxf_utf16_to_utf8 twice(size/allocation then conversion) -> MDVxMXF.openFile NSString.stringWithUTF8String at0x100032440.
textPipeline.surrogates: mxf_utf16_to_utf8 0x100013958 checks high-surrogate followedby low-surrogate, emits4-byte UTF8; malformed isolatedsurrogates return(size_t)-1. convert_string propagates failure, get_string_value propagates failure, ami clipNameread aborts at0x1000100a0->0x100010638.
textPipeline.terminator: Getter stops at first zeroUTF16 codeunit. If none within complete property codeunits, it appends a hostterminator; no mandatory trailing-wire-NUL check. EmbeddedNUL truncates subsequent content.
textPipeline.oddByteLength: Getter uses length>>1; no paritycheck is visible in this bounded path. Trailing odd byte is not consumed as text. Length0/1 becomes empty hoststring.
textPipeline.empty: A presentemptyorleadingNULvalue becomes allocatedempty UTF8 then NSString empty; it is not considered missing by the name path.
textPipeline.noCleanupIdentified: No whitespace trimming, casefolding, NFC/NFD normalization, BOM stripping or MacRoman fallback call appears in traced normalName path.
textPipeline.doNotCopyTolerance: Missingterminator, oddtrailingbyte and veryshortvalue tolerances are tracedbehavior, not recommendations for Bella.

recommendedBella.owner: Read exact GenericPackage.Name on the MaterialPackage already selected by approved identityrules. Name availability does not change selected master. Use same master consistently for its other fields.
recommendedBella.encoding: Known UTF16BE, bounded by property value. Resolve property through Primer/UL and type. No UTF8/MacRoman retry or invented legacy counterpart; preserve characters, case, punctuation and whitespace.
recommendedBella.boundary: Reject odd byte count and malformed text/surrogates within text; stop first U+0000 if present. Accept complete valid text with no terminator at declared boundary, as ST377-1section4.3 permits. No reading beyond bounds.
recommendedBella.absence: Missing/empty/unreadable/conflictingName or unavailable master supplies no MXF ClipName. Database-unavailable MXF fallback displays blank; valid identities/othermetadata and physicalrow survive. No filename,sourcepackagename,trackname or othermaster substitution.
recommendedBella.retention: One owned QString and necessary availability context, small checked new C++17/Qt6.5.3 helpers with QtEndian and QString. Release raw text/header/temporaryreferences; no retained alternatives or name-comparison graph.
recommendedBella.priority: Crosssource priority/opening triggers remain deferred. This source-capability review does not authorize an extra media open or discard a valid MDB name.
